title: Articles
sub: Dated, reviewed, multilingual editorial information. Author one source language, then verify and publish each translation independently.
empty: No articles yet. Create the first one to start a reviewed, dated public record.
rowAction.unpublishBody: The {language} page comes off the public site. The article and its text stay here, and you can publish the language again at any time.
create.title: Create an article
create.hint: Write the source version, choose its reach, then save a draft, publish now, or schedule publication.
create.contentHint: The source language can publish first. Each translation gets its own review and public URL.
create.scopeHint: Global articles appear in every city. City articles belong to one city.
scope.globalHint: Available across InfoKit, with no city restriction.
scope.cityHint: Shown only in the selected city's article listings.
field.organizationHint: The factual owner and custodian. Leave it as InfoKit for proxy-published content.
field.slugHint: Optional. Generated from the title if empty. It stays stable after publication; every language receives its own URL.
field.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
field.sourceLanguageHint: The language you author in first. Translations fall back to it until verified.
field.articleDateHint: The date the information refers to. Shown publicly.
field.featuredHint: Featured articles are highlighted on public listings.
field.title: Title
field.summaryHint: A short summary and key facts must let someone act without reading the full article.
field.tagsHint: Choose up to 3 approved public tags. Tags classify content; they do not grant access.
field.tagsEmpty: No approved public tags are available yet.
tag.createHint: Not listed? Create a public tag for the selected owner. For now, tag creation is available only on this page.
tag.createdNotSelected: Tag created. Remove a selected tag to attach it; an article can have at most 3.
tag.createError: The tag could not be created.
tag.manageGlobalHint: Only the superadmin can rename, archive, or restore tags shared by every organisation.
image.heading: Cover image
image.hint: Optional. The image is reduced, uploaded privately, and must pass the media safety checks before publication.
image.altHint: Describe the useful information in the image for someone who cannot see it.
image.rights: I confirm that InfoKit may publish this image.
image.constraints: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 1 MB. Large images are reduced automatically.
image.removeError: The cover image could not be removed.
image.error: The image could not be uploaded. Check the file, rights confirmation, and storage configuration.
download.heading: Downloadable PDFs
download.hint: Forms or documents readers can download with the article.
download.title: Document title
download.rights: I confirm that InfoKit may publish this document.
download.removeError: The download could not be removed.
download.error: The document could not be uploaded. Check the file, rights confirmation, and storage configuration.
language.optional: Optional — leave empty to omit this language.
publication.heading: Publication
publication.hint: Draft is the safe default. A colleague’s read is optional; the platform’s check is required before anything goes public.
publication.team: Send to a colleague to read
publication.platform: Send to the platform to verify
publication.dateHint: The date is entered in your local time and displayed in Europe/Paris time.
freshness.question: Could this information become outdated?
freshness.canOutdate: Yes — show a public reliability warning
freshness.canOutdateHint: A dated warning appears publicly from the reliability date.
freshness.stable: This information is treated as stable — no dated warning is shown.
freshness.unreliableHint: From this date the public page warns that the information may be outdated.
freshness.sourceSummaryHint: A short note on where this information comes from and how it was verified.
source.title: Traceable sources
source.hint: Cite where the facts come from so the record stays verifiable.
source.name: Source title
action.archiveConfirmBody: Nothing of it is published, so the public sees no change. It keeps its history, and you can restore it later.
translation.heading: Per-language publication
translation.aiNote: AI translated from {source} to {target}. Human review is tracked separately.
translation.publishBlocked: Author a title in this language before publishing.
translation.requestHint: A unique expiring link will give this translator access only to the pinned source and this target language.
translation.requestError: Could not send the translation request
translation.reviewError: Could not save the translation review
translator.title: Translate into {language}
translator.bodyHint: Use blank lines to separate paragraphs. Your work remains private until a reviewer accepts it.
translator.bodyRichHint: Keep the headings, lists and links of the source text. Your work remains private until a reviewer accepts it.
translator.contextHint: For context only, already in your language: these labels are translated centrally and there is nothing to fill in here.
translator.saveError: The translation could not be saved. Try again.
translator.unavailableBody: The link may have expired, been revoked, or already been used. Ask the sender for a new assignment.
translator.state.submitted: Your translation was submitted and is waiting for review.
translator.state.rejected: The translation was not accepted. Contact the sender if you need more information.
translator.state.published: The accepted translation has been published.
translator.profile.openHint: The languages you work in, and the skills and training you have — so the associations send you work you can take on.
translator.profile.title: Your translator profile
translator.profile.notice.title: Why the network asks
translator.profile.notice.purpose: Purpose: so an association can send you work you can actually take on, and can tell whether you may join a mission that has conditions.
translator.profile.notice.visibility: Who reads it: the associations of the network, inside their own workspace. None of it is published — nothing here appears on the public site.
translator.profile.notice.retention: Kept as long as your directory entry exists, and removed with it. Only selections from a shared list are stored: no document, no licence number, no scan.
translator.profile.languagesHint: The whole list is offered, not only the languages the site is published in.
translator.profile.directionHint: At least one of the two. A language you translate into is what an editor searches for; a language you can read a source in is what makes a source that is not French findable at all.
translator.profile.from: I can read a source in it
translator.profile.skillsHint: What the associations share with translators — a driving permit, a tool you know how to use.
translator.profile.coursesHint: Only the trainings an association opened to translators are listed.
translator.profile.stateHint: A ticked badge was confirmed by the association that runs it; a dashed one is waiting for them.
translator.profile.saveError: The profile could not be saved. Try again.
translator.profile.notInDirectoryTitle: This link is not tied to a directory entry
translator.profile.notInDirectoryBody: This content was sent to an email address rather than to a translator the network knows by name, so there is nowhere yet to keep a profile. Ask the association to add you to their translator directory; the next assignment link will then let you fill this in.
preview.chooseTitle: Which language do you want to read?
preview.chooseHint: Only the languages this article is written in are listed.
preview.title: Public preview — {language}
preview.fallback: Showing the {source} source. A verified {target} translation is not yet published.
